observations: Industrial sewing machine on a metal frame table.
Brand 'JINLONG' is visible on the machine head in photo 0.
The machine appears to be in a workshop or garage setting.
A foot pedal is visible at the bottom of the frame.
The machine head is mounted on a vertical arm.
A power cord is visible extending from the machine.
The table surface has a ruler marked in centimeters.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI ABUJA' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have seized internal gears.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running through a full stitch cycle on a piece of fabric.

risks.risk: The motor may be faulty or the belt may be broken.
risks.proof: A video showing the motor running and the needle bar moving.

risks.risk: The machine may have a broken or missing presser foot.
risks.proof: A photo of the presser foot and the area around the needle.

proof_requests: Video of the machine running and sewing.
Photo of the motor and the area where the belt connects to the motor.
Photo of the presser foot and the needle area.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
